scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix cdk && npm install --prefix layers
scripts.cdk:bootstrap:technit: cd cdk && npm install && npx cdk bootstrap --context config=technit --profile=cdk_profile_fo9
scripts.cdk:diff:technit: cd cdk && npx cdk diff --all --context config=technit --profile=cdk_profile_fo9
scripts.cdk:synth:technit: cd cdk && npx cdk synth --all --context config=technit --profile=cdk_profile_fo9
scripts.deploy:technit: cd cdk && npx cdk deploy --all --require-approval never --context config=technit --profile=cdk_profile_fo9
scripts.destroy:technit: cd cdk && npx cdk destroy --all --force --context config=technit --profile=cdk_profile_fo9
scripts.cdk:bootstrap:native: cd cdk && npm install && npx cdk bootstrap --context config=native --profile=cdk_profile_native
scripts.cdk:diff:native: cd cdk && npx cdk diff --all --context config=native --profile=cdk_profile_native
scripts.cdk:synth:native: cd cdk && npx cdk synth --all --context config=native --profile=cdk_profile_native
scripts.deploy:native: cd cdk && npx cdk deploy --all --require-approval never --context config=native --profile=cdk_profile_native
scripts.destroy:native: cd cdk && npx cdk destroy --all --force --context config=native --profile=cdk_profile_native
